title: Torah Research Board
description: Research-board interface combining Jewish texts, commentaries and AI assistance, as described in Sefaria’s directory.
caution: Directory-listed; AI output and citation accuracy not benchmarked.

title: Mekoros
description: Source discovery and source-sheet compilation across Jewish texts. Its site advertises source verification.
caution: Provider claims of “no hallucinations” are not an independent finding; inspect every cited source.

title: Ituria
description: Open-source AI assistant integrating text and commentary retrieval from Sefaria; useful for studying retrieval workflows.
access: Repository; setup and model costs may apply
caution: Review current maintenance, dependencies and licenses before running.

title: PshatGPT
description: Page-contextual Gemara and commentary assistance, according to the Sefaria directory.
caution: Explanations are not critical editions or authoritative rulings.

title: Mishneh AI
description: AI-assisted Jewish-text research and learning tool listed by Sefaria.
caution: Inspect source links and text versions; functionality not independently benchmarked.

title: Torah Scholar MCP
description: A repository connecting AI research workflows to Jewish-text tools and sources.
caution: A developer integration, not a scholarly authority. Review software and source licenses.

title: Jastrow Search
description: A focused search interface for Jastrow, listed in Powered by Sefaria.
caution: Check displayed entries against the dictionary; not a new lexicographic edition.

title: Jastrow App
description: A dedicated digital dictionary interface listed in the Sefaria ecosystem.
caution: Check entry coverage and source edition.

title: Bekiut
description: A Jewish-text reader and study project listed in Powered by Sefaria.
caution: Disclosure: this is guide author Ezra Brand’s project. Listing is not an independent review.

title: Talmud.page
description: A Talmud reading interface listed in Powered by Sefaria.
caution: Check translations and editions before scholarly citation.

title: Kitfei Anaqim
description: A Jewish-text project listed among Sefaria-powered study tools.
caution: Coverage and current functionality require direct review.

title: Sefaria Library Assistant
description: Sefaria’s own AI information and Library Assistant entry point, with discussion of generative-AI limitations.
caution: Retrieved sources and generated synthesis must be checked separately.

title: DICTA tools
description: Hebrew tools including vocalization, citation discovery, translation and library search. The official tools page describes the available services.
caution: Language-model output and automatic text correction can silently alter meaning.

title: AlephBERT
description: Research paper on a Hebrew language model; relevant to computational work on Hebrew text.
caution: A research model is not automatically validated for rabbinic Hebrew or Aramaic.

title: AlephBertGimmel
description: Hebrew NLP model repository from DICTA, useful for computational language research.
caution: Check the model card, training corpus and task suitability.

title: Awesome Hebrew NLP
description: A curated starting list for Hebrew NLP tools, datasets and research.
caution: List inclusion does not establish quality, maintenance or data-use permission.

title: Hebrew and Arabic NLP resources
description: Language-resource discovery portal listed by JewishAI for Hebrew and Arabic NLP.
caution: Check each dataset’s license and historical-language coverage.

title: Sefaria models
description: Sefaria’s model and dataset organization on Hugging Face, a starting point for reproducible experiments.
caution: Read model cards, licenses and intended-use limitations.

title: HaMapah
description: Quantitative analysis of rabbinic responsa; a methodological example of digital Jewish studies.
caution: Digital humanities is broader than generative AI; inspect data and analytical assumptions.

title: AJS Perspectives: AI issue
description: A collection of disciplinary reflections on AI and Jewish studies, listed in JewishAI.
caution: Magazine essays are distinct from peer-reviewed experimental evaluations.

title: AI and Hebrew manuscripts
description: A university overview of AI-related Hebrew manuscript research.
caution: An institutional overview, not a substitute for the underlying methods and data.

title: A Canary in the AI Coal Mine
description: A research preprint listed in JewishAI concerning AI and Jewish textual knowledge.
caution: Check the full paper, revision date and evaluation scope before citing conclusions.

title: What’s Wrong with Hebrew NLP?
description: A methods paper on Hebrew NLP challenges; useful background for evaluating language-processing tools.
caution: Match the paper’s tasks and language variety to your own corpus.

title: Artificial Intelligence and Jewish Thought
description: David Zvi Kalman’s discussion of artificial intelligence and Jewish thought, listed in JewishAI.
caution: Broader conceptual reading; not a technical benchmark or halakhic ruling.
